name: MAX
description: MAX returns the largest value in a range of cells.
tldr: MAX finds the highest value in a range.

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The first number, cell reference, or range.

parameters.name: number2
parameters.description: Optional additional numbers, cell references, or ranges.

basicExample.description: Find the highest value in a range
basicExample.explanation: Returns the largest number from cells A1 through A10.

advancedExamples.title: Max with criteria using MAXIFS
advancedExamples.description: Find the maximum value that meets specific criteria
advancedExamples.explanation: MAXIFS finds the highest value in column A where column B matches "Region A".

howItWorks: MAX scans all numeric values in the specified range and returns the largest one, ignoring text, blank cells, and logical values.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the result should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the maximum value.

limitations: MAX ignores text and blank cells.

commonErrors.fix: Check your data range contains numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: MAX works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does MAX consider dates?
faq.answer: Yes, dates are stored as serial numbers, so MAX can find the latest date.

faq.question: What if all cells are empty?
faq.answer: MAX returns 0 if all cells are empty.
